notes: Courses are Algebra 1, Geometry and Algebra 2 (site paths /HS/teachers/1, /2, /3), filed as grades 9, 10, 11. The site groups lessons in each unit under unnumbered section titles, so section "n" is null; order is the page order. Lesson "url" is the teacher preparation page; "practiceUrl" is the public practice page, null where the site has none. Course 4 (Algebra 1 Supports, extra-support lessons that shadow Algebra 1) is not a textbook course and is not included. Skills are the best-matching taxonomy ids; see unit notes.
